第一步：按Win+R键打开“运行”窗口

So we spent a lot of time to remake the entire driving system

Linear

stability

speed

notes.title: Something about the coming patch 1.0
notes.notes:
Hello

After more than half a year’s EA period, we got a lot supporting from our players.
Although we are a new team, our basic principal never changed- Make a game which player loves.
During this period, we made a lot of modification and adjustment. At the same time, we also bring out some new functions and vehicles.
And in several weeks ago, we decided to add more languages into our game for the players all over the world.
By the same time, we plan to finish our EA period, the 1.0 will be full version, but our attitude will never change.

These new elements will be released freely in the full version:

Guangdong Province 
Dump Truck
Old Fashion Box Truck (Brand: Jiefang)
Motor Tricycle
Online-Mode Open Beta (It will be adjusted based on actual progress)

We all know that our game is not perfect now, our graphics, details are not good enough. After 1.0 version released, we will keep on working on these problems, and our plan of travelling around China will never stop.

notes.title: TruckLife ---- Fujian Province
notes.notes:
As part of TruckLife’s free update, Fujian Province will be available in next major update.

Fujian Province (as known as “Min”), with its capital Fuzhou City is located in southeast coast of China, its neighboring provinces are Zhejiang to the northeast, Jiangxi to the west and northwest, and Guangdong to the southwest. It faces Taiwan across the Taiwan Strait. Fujian Province has 9 prefecture-level cities, they are Fuzhou, Putian,  Quanzhou,  Xiamen, Zhangzhou, Longyan, Sanming, Nanping and Ningde, it also has one comprehensive experimental area: Pingtan.

The geographical feature of Fujian Province is “along with the mountains and the sea.” 90% of the land is hilly landscape, it is also known as “eight parts of mountains, one part water, and one part farmland.” Most of these hilly area are covered by forests, its forest coverage as high as 65.95%, which ranks the first place in China. Fujian also has the second longest coastline in China, it is rugged and has many bays and islands, which is 3751.5 km long. There are more than 1,500 islands in Fujian Province, and Haitan Island is the largest island in Fujian Province now.

Please keep in touch, we will try our best to make this game perfect.

Taizhou- LIshui, which is passing by Yubei village, is the longest, the most dangerous and the most exciting mountain path in the game. notes.title: TruckLife 0.0.32 Mission system update
notes.notes:
1.In the past mission system, cargoes are signed to its preset destination and cannot be changed. Now players can choose to ship wherever they want to without restriction.
When you start from the Zhinan Village, you used to be only able to ship the cargo to Hangzhou. However, now you can ship the cargo to any open city like Shanghai, Taizhou, Longquan and so on.

2. As usual, you can still check the cargo availability in any city any time.
You just have to open the destination selection in mission interface, click “select departure city” on top left corner, then click on whichever city you want to check.

3.Another main effect is whichever type of truck and at any cargo yard you are using, you can always choose to do long-distance transportation mission to increase your income and afford your favorite truck.

4.To help this new feature, we increase the weight of distance in the cargo pricing. Compare to the past, the long-distance transport provide more profit, in other word, making money is easier.
